note: Routt NF (Parks RD) campground beside 343-acre Big Creek Lake at ~9,000 ft near the Mount Zirkel Wilderness, about an hour (35 mi) NW of Walden via CO-125, CR 6W and gravel FR 600. Mostly large gravel pull-throughs in lodgepole and fir; pine-beetle thinning has opened some sites to sun. Moose often seen. No potable water at present: bring your own. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 231864: confirmed 54 sites (24 reservable / 30 FCFS), pull-throughs, vault toilets, no potable water (FS: no date for its return), $20 (2027 also $20). Changed max_rig_ft 40 -> 50 (rec.gov catalog, 6 sites at 50 ft; 5 at 20 ft). Added booking.season 06-06..09-14 from the 2026 rate period, 7-day cutoff and host in booking.note, season as a note (early June to mid/late Oct). Note cleaned.
flags: Missing phone: Parks Ranger District (970) 723-2700 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/offices; also recreation.gov's facility phone).

Road/access alert (not a closure): 'Access Impact: Big Creek Lakes Dam Project' - heavy equipment and construction at the lower reservoir dam, 'No closures are in place, however equipment is traveling/operating along Forest Roads 600 and 660. The public should use caution along those roads and near Big Creek Lakes Campground', six days a week through December 31, 2026. Parks RD conditions (as of 10/20/2026): 'All Campgrounds closed for the season' - ordinary seasonal closing.

Lakefront (stored) - which sites: the 24 reservable sites with catalog points split two ways. Sites 043, 044 and 045 lie on Big Creek Lake's north-shore loop, ~35-40 m from the waterline, across partly open ground with a sand/gravel beach strip and a path to the shore at 043/044 (trees between in places); the 30 first-come sites are not in the catalog, but the north-shore loop between those points appears to hold more spurs in the same position. The main west loops (sites 002-034) sit ~60-200 m back from the west shore in lodgepole forest, with the shore road between. So lakefront holds for the north-shore loop only; the ground there is mostly open. Waterfront not changed.

Pin 40.93639,-106.61167 is the rec.gov/FS facility point by the north-shore entrance road, ~400 m NE of the centroid of the catalog points (40.93414,-106.61545), which are dominated by the west loops. Catalog points 024 (40.9178,-103.5297, in eastern Colorado) and the shared point of 023/029/051 are bad data.

Max length: the stored 40 ft came from note prose; the rec.gov catalog has six sites (007, 009, 010, 012, 015, 017) at 50 ft, which is not one of the known placeholder values. The FS page states no maximum. Five catalogued sites are 20 ft, so not every site fits EKKO.
